import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_63/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_63/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_63/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_63/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_63/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_63/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_63/training_6.csv", index_col=0)

# Concatenate all sources (UNION)
df = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3, source4, source5, source6], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure column types match target schema:
# 'nombre': string
df['nombre'] = df['nombre'].astype(str)
# 'n_concursados': integer
df['n_concursados'] = df['n_concursados'].astype(int)
# 'n_aprobados': integer
df['n_aprobados'] = df['n_aprobados'].astype(int)
# 'año': integer
df['año'] = df['año'].astype(int)

# The target key is (nombre, año), so drop duplicates on these keys keeping the first occurrence
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['nombre', 'año'], keep='first')

# Sort by 'nombre' and 'año' for consistent output (optional)
df = df.sort_values(by=['nombre', 'año']).reset_index(drop=True)

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index column
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_63/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
